handoff.title: Team 交接預覽
handoff.checking: 正在核對伺服器版本和工作區…
handoff.disclaimer: 這是唯讀的規則檢查，不是真實模型分析。結果僅代表本次檢查時的狀態，未來交接仍須由後端重新驗證。本預覽不會建立 Team、啟動 Agent、傳送訊息或修改執行狀態。

reasons.invalidDraft: 任務草稿結構或版本不合法。
reasons.invalidSource: Draft source must match its version: v1 is rules-based and v2 is model-generated.
reasons.invalidRevision: 任務草稿 revision 必須是正的安全整數。
reasons.tooManyTasks: 任務數量超過後端允許的 100 條上限。
reasons.invalidId: 任務 {{taskId}}：ID 須為 1–64 位英文字母、數字、底線或連字號。
reasons.missingDependency: 任務 {{taskId}} 的前置相依 {{dependency}} 不存在。
reasons.selfDependency: 任務 {{taskId}} 存在自我相依。
reasons.duplicateDependency: 任務 {{taskId}} 的前置相依 {{dependency}} 重複。
reasons.emptyCriteria: 任務 {{taskId}} 至少需要一條非空驗收標準。
reasons.invalidTask: 任務 {{taskId}} 的類型、工作量、角色或清單欄位不合法。
reasons.staleRevision: 頁面 revision 已過期，請返回執行詳情並重新載入後再交接。
reasons.snapshotChanged: 頁面與伺服器內容不一致。本機編輯已保留，請先審閱並同步修改。
reasons.alreadyHandedOff: 目前執行記錄已關聯 Team 或已進入執行階段，不可重複交接。
reasons.invalidStatus: 目前執行記錄不處於任務草稿就緒階段。
reasons.invalidWorkspace: 工作區須為絕對路徑，且不能包含首尾空白或空字元。
reasons.workspaceUnavailable: 無法驗證工作區：存取被拒絕或中繼資料服務不可用。
reasons.serverUnavailable: 無法讀取伺服器目前版本，不能確認交接條件。
reasons.invalidScope: Task {{taskId}} has an invalid execution scope.
reasons.uncoveredRequirement: Requirement {{dependency}} is not covered by the task graph.
reasons.invalidIntegration: The graph needs one final integration test card whose dependencies cover all other tasks and which has no successor.
reasons.versionNotReady: This version has not completed copying or its copy failed. Handoff remains blocked.

execution.description: This confirmation creates a Team and pending task graph. It does not start Agents or send development messages.
execution.success: Tasks are connected to the Team. Start development below or inspect the execution results.
execution.openTeamWarning: The existing Team page initializes member sessions when opened. Enter only when you are ready; handoff does not navigate automatically.
execution.revisionError: The task draft changed. Close this dialog, reload the run and review the latest revision before retrying.
execution.blockedError: The backend rejected the handoff conditions. Recheck the confirmed draft and workspace before retrying.
execution.preparationError: Team members could not be prepared or cleaned up. Check the configured assistants/models and service logs before retrying.
execution.requestError: The handoff result could not be confirmed. Your draft is retained. Retry or reload the run; the same revision will not create another Team.

home.title: 把產品想法變成可執行的開發方案
home.description: 補全需求、確認藍圖、拆解任務，再交給現有 Agent 團隊執行。
home.emptyDescription: 先輸入一句話想法，產品工廠會協助產生藍圖與可執行的任務關係。

form.title: 描述你想開發的產品
form.description: 現在只需填寫產品名稱與想法，其他資訊可以在需求補全流程中完善。
form.ideaPlaceholder: 說明它協助誰、解決什麼問題，以及你希望得到什麼成果。
form.targetUserPlaceholder: 例如：產品經理與獨立創業者
form.problemPlaceholder: 目前哪件事太慢、太貴或不可靠？
form.expectedOutputPlaceholder: 例如：可以執行的桌面端原型
form.workspacePlaceholder: Leave empty for a managed local product folder, or enter an existing absolute path
form.budgetHint: 已記錄支出達到此上限後，後端預算護欄會暫停新的 Agent 回合。
form.startError: 建立執行記錄失敗，請稍後重試。

interview.title: 需求訪談
interview.description: 回答這些問題，把最初的想法整理成清晰的產品需求。

blueprint.title: 藍圖審閱
blueprint.description: 在拆解開發任務前，先確認產品結構和技術方案。

workspace.notFound: 找不到這筆產品執行記錄。
workspace.actionError: 更新失敗，草稿仍然保留，請重試。

execution.title: 首個開發任務
execution.description: 明確確認後，把首個無相依任務派給僅設定一名 Leader 的 Team。開啟頁面不會啟動開發。
execution.confirmDescription: 此操作可能啟動你設定的 Agent、產生模型費用，並修改所選專案目錄。目錄不是安全沙箱。本次只派發首個任務，不代表產品已交付。
execution.enqueued: 任務訊息已被 Team 接收。Agent 是否實際執行，請在 Team 中核查。
execution.pending: 已保留一次派發嘗試，但結果尚未確認。請到 Team 核查；此頁面不會自動重複投遞。
execution.uncertain: 派發結果不確定，訊息可能已經寫入。請先到 Team 核查，再決定後續操作。
execution.disclaimer: 此回執不證明已產生程式碼、通過品質檢查或交付可執行產品。
execution.readError: 無法讀取派發紀錄。為避免重複執行，已停用啟動操作。
execution.requestError: 無法確認啟動回應。正在重新讀取派發紀錄，不會自動重試投遞。
execution.blocked: 目前不能執行。請在 Team 檢查單 Leader 設定、工作區、任務狀態和剩餘預算。
execution.revisionError: 已確認的任務版本發生變化，請重新載入產品後再操作。
execution.costUnknown: 目前已設定預算，但無法核驗模型成本。為避免超出預算，暫時不能啟動。

taskDraft.title: Task draft review
taskDraft.description: Review the task graph against the confirmed blueprint. Its source is shown above. Confirmation does not start development.
taskDraft.noAgent: The task list is confirmed and has not been handed to an Agent.
taskDraft.dependenciesField: Blocked by task IDs, comma separated
taskDraft.scopeHint: Task workspace is the default. Only one final integration card may assemble the product root after all artifact tasks. Backend checks are authoritative.

review.title: Human review
review.description: Check the task evidence before approving or requesting changes. Continuing to the next task is always explicit.
review.feedbackPlaceholder: Explain what must change before approval
review.approvedNext: Approved. The next task is unlocked but has not started.
review.productComplete: All planned tasks have been approved.
review.resumeHint: Use this after requesting changes or an interrupted task. Existing work is preserved. The backend refuses to dispatch while an Agent turn is already active.

delivery.notReady: Tasks are approved, but delivery checks still need attention.
delivery.verifyHint: Open START.md in the project folder and verify the product starts, stops, and reopens correctly. These checks confirm recorded status and files; they do not run the product for you.
delivery.unknownCost: Some usage or model pricing is unavailable. The total cost is unknown and is not counted as zero.
delivery.exportError: The cost report could not be downloaded. Please retry.
delivery.loadError: Delivery checks are not available yet. Refresh the review data to retry.

checks.budget_within_limit: 設定預算時，記錄費用未達預算上限

delivery.repriceHint: 依已設定費率估算完整記錄；已知金額與不完整歷史記錄會保留。
delivery.repriceResult: 已更新 {{updated}} 筆記錄；{{skipped}} 筆未重新估算。
delivery.repriceError: 重新估算失敗，請重新整理後再試。
delivery.attemptCountHint: Attempt counts include records proven not to have called a model. Those records cost zero; other unknown costs remain unknown.

planning.title: Model planning
planning.description: Generate questions, a blueprint or a task graph with one configured assistant. Model use may incur charges; results remain candidates until you apply and review them.
planning.savedInputHint: Planning uses the saved requirements. Save your edits before starting or applying a candidate.
planning.rulesAvailable: You can also continue with the clearly labelled rules-based draft below.
planning.oneAssistant: Select exactly one configured assistant. Its configured or last-used model is reused; this operation generates a candidate.
planning.applyHint: Applying replaces the saved draft. Review and confirm it separately before development; the model does not confirm its own output.
planning.unknownCost: Unavailable usage or pricing keeps the run cost unknown. Unknown costs are never counted as zero.
planning.readError: Planning records could not be loaded. Generation is disabled until a successful refresh.
planning.requestError: The operation response could not be confirmed. Reload persisted records before acting again; no model request is retried automatically.
planning.uncertainHint: A previous attempt has an uncertain outcome. Inspect the conversation and usage records before any further generation. This page will not resend it.
planning.staleCandidate: Saved requirements changed after this candidate was generated. It cannot overwrite the newer revision.

errors.sendAdmissionRejected: The local admission check rejected this Send before calling the backend. Check its budget, call ownership and usage records; earlier calls remain recorded.
errors.uncertainAttempt: An earlier planning attempt has an uncertain outcome. Inspect its records before starting another attempt; it will not be replayed automatically.
errors.conversationNotBound: This conversation has no valid planning-run binding. Check the persisted planning record.
errors.attemptNotRunning: The persisted planning attempt is no longer running or belongs to a different run. It cannot send a new prompt.
errors.appTurnNotBound: The current application turn could not be verified against the planning record. No new Send was admitted.
errors.cancellationUnconfirmed: Cancellation could not be confirmed. The model may still be running and its costs remain recorded; no stop or refund is implied.

versions.title: Code versions and iteration
versions.scopeHint: 版本保留選定程式碼與靜態資源。選擇版本會切換程式碼路徑；執行中的服務和業務資料需按應用約定重新啟動或遷移。
versions.reviewSource: Review files and save a code version
versions.completeBeforeSnapshot: Complete and approve the development workflow before creating a code snapshot. Unknown model pricing does not block this local file operation.
versions.manifestHint: 核對所選原始碼、靜態資源及啟動和驗收說明。常見資料庫、執行資料和憑證檔案會被過濾；儲存前請檢查檔案內容。檔案雜湊對應本次明確選擇。
versions.requiredFiles: Select START.md, ACCEPTANCE.md and the code needed to run the product.
versions.iterationHint: This copies the sealed code into an independent working folder and creates a requirement draft. Interview, blueprint and task confirmation are still required; no model or development task starts automatically.
versions.independentBudget: This budget belongs to the new run. Existing usage and costs remain recorded in their original runs.
versions.createIteration: Create and open the new draft
versions.readError: Version state is unavailable. Refresh before changing versions.
versions.operationError: The operation response could not be confirmed. Read durable records before retrying; this page does not repeat writes automatically.
versions.copyingHint: The working copy is not complete. Planning, handoff and activation remain blocked for this run. An interrupted operation is retained; a new request must be explicit.
versions.failedHint: This working version failed to copy. Inspect the recorded error and create a new request from a sealed source; the failed record remains preserved.
versions.pendingHint: A submitted request is retained with its original key and payload. Refresh its receipt. A changed request needs fresh file inspection and a new key.
versions.newRequest: Discard the local request and review a new one
versions.unregistered: This older run has no code version registered yet.
versions.activationResult: The selected code folder is {{path}}. Business data was not migrated and no process was started.
